title: Voice Arena Speech Recognition Benchmark with Monsoon conversational test set
headline: Voice Arena launches conversational speech recognition benchmark
lede: Teams can compare speech recognition on two-person conversations in five languages using the Monsoon test set and a public leaderboard.

effects.effect: Speech benchmarks shift toward real conversations

with.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: open 30B MoE speech model

possibilities.connection: Voice Arena's Monsoon set tests two-person conversations in five languages, and Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an Apache-2.0 model that arrived with no accuracy numbers, so the benchmark fills its missing evidence.
